$comment: THE INSPECTOR'S PER-SCREEN PROMISE, AS DATA (RULE CFG; BATCH LE-2 V-5). sharedKeys: what a change made while another screen is being edited still writes for EVERY screen — the words, links and pictures, and the effects (the published page carries an effect for every screen: LE2-4). Everything else is that screen's own. banner / deviceTab: what the Inspector says while a screen other than the desktop is being edited; {screen} is that screen's name, {reach} the screens the change shows on (config/layout.json rungs' words, joined), {shared} the line about what stays shared.

perScreen.banner: Editing {screen} — what you change here (size, spacing, colours, fonts, backgrounds) shows on {reach}. A control that says “every screen” changes them all.
perScreen.shared: Words, links, pictures and effects are the same on every screen.
perScreen.deviceTab: You're editing {screen}. Sizes, spacing and looks you change now show on {reach}. A control marked “every screen” changes them all.
perScreen.narrowerToo: {own} — and on {narrower} too, unless you change it there
